name: One Night Revolution
summary: One-night social deduction where rebels must find and vote out a hidden government informant using specialist powers.
rules_text: Each player gets a secret ID token (Rebel or Informant) plus a secret Specialist card giving a night power; three extra IDs go to the HQ. At night eyes closed, controller leads informants to recognize each other, then clockwise each player opens eyes alone to do their Specialist action which may look at or swap ID tokens. By day, players in order claim a Specialist token (may lie) then discuss freely for 5-10 minutes, without looking at cards, trying to deduce current alignments. Then all simultaneously point at someone to Terminate. Most-voted players reveal IDs. If any Informant is terminated, Rebels win. If none or only Rebels are terminated, Informants win. Rebels can also win by voting in a circle with zero eliminations if all Informant tokens are correctly believed to be on HQ.
rating_reason: Social deduction secret identities with roles and voting
